lines.en: What two interruptions did the writer have?
lines.zh: 作者遇到了哪两次打扰？

lines.en: After breakfast, I sent the children to school and then I went to the shops.
lines.zh: 早饭后，我把孩子们送到学校，然后就去商店了。

lines.en: It was still early when I returned home.
The children were at school, my husband was at work and the house was quiet.
lines.zh: 孩子们在学校，我丈夫去上班了，家里很安静。

lines.en: So I decided to make some meat pies.
lines.zh: 于是我决定做些肉馅饼。

lines.en: In a short time I was busy mixing butter
lines.zh: 没过多久，我就忙着搅和黄油

lines.en: and flour and my hands were soon covered with sticky pastry.
lines.zh: 和面粉，很快我的手上就沾满了黏糊糊的面团。

lines.en: At exactly that moment, the telephone rang.
Nothing could have been more annoying.
lines.zh: 没有什么比这更烦人的了。

lines.en: I picked up the receiver between two sticky fingers and was dismayed when I recognized the voice of Helen Bates.
lines.zh: 我用两根黏糊糊的手指拿起听筒，当认出海伦·贝茨的声音时，我感到很沮丧。

lines.en: It took me ten minutes to persuade her to ring back later. At last I hung up the receiver.
lines.zh: 我花了十分钟才说服她稍后再打来。最后我挂断了电话。

lines.en: What a mess! There was pastry on my fingers, on the telephone, and on the doorknobs.
lines.zh: 真是一团糟！我的手指上、电话上、门把手上都沾满了面团。

lines.en: I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang loud enough to wake the dead.
lines.zh: 我刚回到厨房，门铃就响了，声音大得足以把死人吵醒。

lines.en: This time it was the postman and he wanted me to sign for a registered letter!
lines.zh: 这次是邮递员，他要我签收一封挂号信！
